matter_background.original: Kanthi Peiris is a Notary practicing in Colombo. Shantha Ratnayake is her brother-in-law and is the owner of an apartment in Negambo. Shantha wishes to lease out his apartment for 3 years at a monthly rental of Rs.120,000/= to one Ananda Gamage who is willing to take on lease in accordance with the said terms. However, Shantha who lives in Negambo is unable to come to Colombo to sign the Agreement.
